note: Each finished story is booked in Zernio at the next free time below (UTC), in story order, three a day; posts.json lists what's booked. series.lesson does the same for the render lessons (lessons/): one a day at 16:00, YouTube only. series.upload books the videos made elsewhere (uploads/, ids starting yt-: the Rhino plug-in how-to and its Shorts) on YouTube at its own times, not before its "from": one a day, so YouTube stays under the channel's 10 uploads a day with the stories, lessons and Social. series.feature does the same for the two-tone videos (uploads/, ids starting ft-) on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, one a day at 20:30 from 1 Nov (after the YouTube re-posts of 30-31 Oct). now lists videos that post the moment they're made. paused: true stops new bookings (posts already booked stay booked in Zernio). accounts are the HeyGema accounts in Zernio; YouTube's id is read from Zernio.
